page.layout: One page: a single chronological table with a running head above and a gathering signature below. Columns from left to right: Anni Iul., Lit. dom., Nabonasari, Feriae (with Aug. dates in a bracketed column), Christi. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Anni Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabonasari | Feriæ. | Christi.

page.notes: A handwritten or pen mark ("b") stands in the left margin beside the rows 77–78; it is not printed and is left out. The Aug. dates are printed in a dash-bracketed column beside the Feriae column. Printed spelling "Feriæ." kept as printed. Running head printed "ANNORVM", spelled ANNORUM by the u/v rule.
